ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολεμιστήν: πολεμιστής — warrior, fighter; masc. acc. sg.
πολιῆς: πολιός — grey (of the sea); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
πολλῶν: πολύς — much, many; gen. pl., of persons: ’of many (men)’
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
πριαμίδην: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρό τε παίδων ’for the children’)
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’much, greatly’ (πόλλ’ ἀεκαζομένη ’much against her will’)
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
σακέων: σάκος — shield; neut. gen. pl., uncontracted (= Attic σακῶν)
σταδίῃ: σταδίη (sc. ὑσμίνη) — standing fight, close fighting; fem. dat. sg., adj. used as noun: ’in the stand-up fight’
στρατοῦ: στρατός — army, host; masc. gen. sg.
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σχεδόν: σχεδόν — near, close at hand; adv.
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε (elided τ’): ’you’ (σύ τ’ ἐϋφρήνῃς ’that you may gladden’)
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάνυσσαν: τανύω — stretch, stretch out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, doubled σσ (= Attic ἐτάνυσαν)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’)
ταρβεῖ: ταρβέω — be afraid, be dismayed; pres. 3 sg. act., contracted (ταρβέει)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῖοι: τοῖος — such, of such a sort; masc. nom. pl.: ’of such a kind’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’)
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὰρ: ἄρα — then, so; τὰρ is taken as τε + ἄρα run together (compare τίς τ’ ἄρ), after interrogative τίς: ’who then?’ · also after interrogative πῶς: ’how then?’ (πῶς τὰρ ἔοι τάδε ἔργα ’how then could this be?’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῳ: τις, τι — someone, anyone; masc./neut. dat. sg. (= τινί), enclitic: ’to anyone’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup)
υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’ · also masc. acc. dual, in apposition to ἀνέρε: ’two sons’ (υἷε δύω Μέροπος)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φλογὶ: φλόξ — flame, blaze; fem. dat. sg., dat. of likeness: ’(like) flame’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέοντε: φρονέω — think, be minded, be proud; pres. part. masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντε)
φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg. · also φόβος — flight, fear (not personified); masc. nom. sg.: ’terror’ (φόβος ἔλλαβε πάντας ’terror seized all’)
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’)
χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χερμαδίοισιν: χερμάδιον — stone (a hand-sized throwing stone); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
χρὼς: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; masc. nom. sg.
ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγοὶ: ἀγός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
ἀγὸς: ἀγός — leader, commander; masc. nom. sg.
ἀκάχοιτο: ἀκαχίζω — distress, grieve; mid. be grieved; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., reduplicated aor., with κε: ’would be grieved’
ἀλέεινε: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun, shrink from; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + inf.: ’shrank from’ · also impf. 3 sg., + acc.: ’avoided’ (ἀλέεινε μάχην ’avoided the fighting’)
ἀλεξέμεναι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀλέξειν): ’to defend’
ἀλκὴν: ἀλκή — strength, might, prowess; fem. acc. sg.
ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also masc. dat. pl., indirect object of ὄπασσον: ’to both’ · also masc. dat. pl., instrumental, agreeing with ποσσίν: ’(with) both (feet)’
ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also dat. of interest: ’for both’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀμύνειν: ἀμύνω — ward off (+ acc. of what is warded off); pres. inf. act.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’)
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀρετὴ: ἀρετή — excellence, valour; fem. nom. sg.
ἀρετὴν: ἀρετή — excellence, worth, prowess; fem. acc. sg.
ἀρᾶται: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’prays that’
ἀτάλαντος: ἀτάλαντος — equal (in weight), a match for; adj., masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’equal to’
ἀτρέμας: ἀτρέμας — without moving, calmly, quietly; adv.
ἀφίκοντο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιϊκὸν: Ἀχαιϊκός — Achaean; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with οὖθαρ
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἁλός: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’)
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, blast of wind; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in another direction, elsewhere; adv.; ἄλλυδις ἄλλος ’one this way, one that’
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγχείῃσι: ἐγχείη — spear (= ἔγχος); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), instrumental
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναιρέμεν: ἐναίρω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐναίρειν), epexegetic: ’to kill’
ἐνεμέσσα: νεμεσάω — feel resentment, be indignant at (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἐνεμέσα): ’felt resentment’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξεφαάνθη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐξεφάνη): ’appeared’
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’
ἐρητύετ: ἐρητύω — restrain, hold back; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἐρητύετ’ = ἐρητύετο)
ἐρχομένων: ἔρχομαι — go, come, march; pres. part. mid. gen. pl. masc.: ’of those going’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσεῖται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἐσσεῖται (= Attic ἔσται)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐσσύμενον: σεύω — drive, hurry (mid. rush, hasten); perf. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg., epic doubled σ, agreeing with σε: ’hurrying’
ἐφόβησε: φοβέω — put to flight, scare; aor. 3 sg. act., gnomic (in a simile): ’puts to flight’ · also aor. 3 sg. act., plain narrative: ’put to flight’ (Δαναοὺς ἐφόβησε ’put the Danaans to flight’)
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑσταότες: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ἑσταότες (= Attic ἑστῶτες): ’standing’
ἔβησαν: βαίνω — go, walk, set off; aor. 3 pl.: ’they went’
ἔγειρε: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; 3 sg. aor. or impf. act., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε): ’roused’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hearken to (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), in a general statement: ’they hear’ · also aor. 1 sg. + gen. of the speaker: ’I heard (it from one who told it)’
ἔλπομαι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid./dep., + inf.: ’I expect’
ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’ · also ’set free, released’ (a captive, for ransom)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ)
ἔναρα: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from a slain foe; neut. acc. pl., object of φέροι
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔντεσι: ἔντεα — armour, gear; neut. pl., dat. -εσι: ’in armour’
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., with movable ν: ’is’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕσπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐ-σπ-ετο, root σεπ-), the augment absorbed: ’followed’
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question · also ἠέ, ’or’, introducing a further alternative in a list (ἠέ ποθι ’or somewhere’) · also ἠέ, ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠέ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’) · also ἠέ, ’than’, after a verb of wishing, with no comparative: ’rather than’ (δοῦναι κράτος ἠέ περ ἡμῖν ’to give strength rather than to us’) · also ἠέ … ἠέ, correlative ’either … or’, in a statement · also ἠέ … ἦέ, ’either … or’ (’whether … or’), in a direct double question (ἠέ τι βέβληαι … ἦέ τευ ἀγγελίης ’have you been hit … or have you come with news’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἡρώεσσιν: ἥρως — hero; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἥρωσιν)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤχθετο: ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be distressed, be burdened (from ἄχθος ’load’); impf. 3 sg. mid.-pass., augmented: ’was distressed’
ἤϊσαν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ᾖσαν): ’went’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε), second member of an alternative question
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’
ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰλιόθι: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; ἰλιόθι, locative adv. with suffix -θι: ’at Ilios’
ἴα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg., epic ἴα (= Attic μία)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵσταμαι: ἵστημι — set up; mid. stand; pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I stand (before)’
ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; mid. take one’s stand; impf. 3 sg. mid., masc. sg. subject: ’stood forth, took his stand’
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. inf. mid.: ’to perish’
ὀμίχλην: ὀμίχλη — mist, fog; fem. acc. sg.
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀρέξομεν: ὀρέγω — stretch out, hold out, grant; fut. 1 pl. act.: ’we shall reach out, we shall grant’
ὁμοιΐου: ὁμοίϊος — common to all, shared (sense disputed; ’impartial’ and ’levelling’ also guessed); masc. gen. sg.
ὁμὸν: ὁμός — same, common; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’the same’
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
ὑσμίνῃ: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
